en.headline: Sha Tin public housing tenant jailed six weeks over undeclared Tai Po flat
en.dek: The Housing Department said a Wo Che Estate resident who declared no Hong Kong property in 2025 in fact owned a home in Tai Po, and the public rental flat will be recovered.
body: A public rental housing tenant living at Wo Che Estate in Sha Tin was jailed for six weeks on Monday after a Sha Tin magistrates' court found the resident had made a false statement about property ownership, the Housing Department said.

The department said the tenant stated on a 2025 income and assets declaration form that no domestic property was owned in Hong Kong. An investigation later found that at the relevant time the resident held a residential property in Tai Po. Prosecutors treated the case as a false statement under the Housing Ordinance.

The magistrate imposed an immediate custodial sentence after considering the seriousness of the offence and the value of public housing resources. The Housing Department said it will recover the Wo Che Estate unit.

A department spokesman reminded public housing tenants and subsidised-housing applicants to declare income, assets and property accurately and to follow the form instructions when calculating those figures. The department said it will keep using a range of measures against abuse so that public flats go to households that qualify.

zh.headline: 禾輏邸公屋戶隱瞞大埔物業 判監六星期單位將收回
zh.dek: 房屋署表示，該戶在二〇二五年申報表填報並無本港物業，其後被揭發當時持有大埔住宅，公屋單位將被收回。
body: 房屋署表示，一名居於沙田禾輏邸的公屋住戶，周一在沙田裁判法院被裁定作出虛假陳述，判監六星期即時執行。
署方指，該住戶在二〇二五年填寫入息及資產申報表時，申報並無擁有香港住宅物業。房屋署調查後發現，發案期間該人實際上持有大埔一個住宅物業，涉嫌違反《房屋條例》作出虛假陳述。
裁判官考慮案情嚴重及涉及公屋資源，判處即時監禁。房屋署表示將收回該禾輏邸單位。
房屋署發言人提醒公屋住戶及資助房屋申請人，必須如實申報入息、資產及物業，並按表格指示計算。署方重申會繼續以多管齊下方式打擊濫用公屋，確保公共房屋資源分配予符合資格的家庭。
